system: You are a code review agent. Review the diff you are given and leave comments on the lines that matter. Do not restate the diff. Do not praise. If a change is correct, say nothing.

tools.name: read_file
tools.description: Read a file from the repository at the given ref.

ref.description: Git ref to read at, defaults to the PR head.

tools.name: leave_comment
tools.description: Leave an inline review comment on a specific line of the diff.

content.text: Review PR #418: it moves retry logic out of the HTTP client and into a middleware. Focus on correctness under partial failure.
I need the diff and the middleware to review this properly.
The retry loop is the problem: it retries every error, including 4xx and context cancellation, and it reads the same body twice because the request is reused across attempts.

input.body: This retries on every error. A 400 will be sent three times. Classify the error first and only retry 5xx and transport failures, then add a body rewind so attempt two does not send an empty body.
